description: Map of repo full-name (owner/repo) to its role in the pilot

base_branch.description: Branch a fresh agent-hq/<issue> branch is cut from

setup.description: Shell commands run in the worktree before the agent starts, per task id. 'default' applies to any task without its own entry; a task id overrides it. Structured setup belongs here, not in a prompt: it costs no agent requests, fails loudly, and is the same every run. The command may leave notes for the agent at .agent-hq/setup-notes.md.
